title: Guardian Operator Handbook: RBACv2 Admin Procedures, Audit Triage & SSO Recovery
creator: Maya Chen
description:
Purpose: Provide a concise, actionable handbook for privileged operators and support engineers to manage RBAC v2 rollout, triage audit log findings, and recover from SSO/SAML identity provider incidents. This doc is intended for oncall responders, support engineers, and platform operators who must perform safe admin actions with full auditability.

Scope: - Admin workflows for role assignment, temporary elevation (just-in-time), and emergency sudo-like patterns.
- Audit query patterns and ticketable evidence artifacts for internal/external compliance requests.
- SSO/SAML outage playbook: failover steps, IdP health checks, metadata rotation, and user session revocation.
- Support macros for fast triage (copy-paste) and PR/communication templates to update customers and security stakeholders.

Non-goals: This is not a tutorial on RBAC design or a deep dive into the control plane code; it assumes RBAC v2 policies are published and enforced by the control plane.

Why now: RBAC v2 is in broad rollout; we have had two oncall incidents where confusion about temporary admin grants and missing audit evidence slowed incident closure. This handbook synthesizes lessons from those incidents and standardizes macros and evidence collection to reduce MTTR and improve compliance readiness.
acceptance_criteria: Handbook contains clear step-by-step procedures for: grant/revoke of privileged roles, JIT elevation window creation, and emergency rollback
Audit triage section includes reproducible query patterns (time-bounded, actor-filtered) and a checklist for evidence attachment to tickets
SSO/SAML incident playbook lists exact IdP endpoints to check, metadata rotation steps, and a safe rollback path to pause SSO enforcement while preserving audit trails
At least 6 support macros created (copyable), validated in staging, and added to the support macro library with usage examples
Security review sign-off captured and the runbook published to the operator runbook index with a versioned filename

support_macros: Macro: /grant-temp-admin --payload: {user_email, role, duration_minutes} => creates JIT grant and attaches grant_id to ticket (use only with approver)
Macro: /evidence-bundle --params: {start_ts, end_ts, principal} => collects audit logs, kv-cache events, and session tokens snapshot into artifact
Macro: /sso-failover-checklist => run automated IdP endpoint checks, cert expiry, and last-successful-assertion timestamps, returns formatted summary
Macro: /revoke-sessions --user:email => revoke active sessions for user and log revocation event id
Macro: /snapshot-policies --scope:org => export RBAC v2 policy snapshot and SHA256 for compliance attachment
Macro: /notify-customer-incident => templated message with incident id, affected scopes, and mitigation steps (copyable)
runbook_steps: Step 1 - Confirm scope: identify affected orgs/projects and list principals with privileged access during incident window
Step 2 - Collect evidence: run /evidence-bundle for time window plus 5m buffer; attach artifact to the ticket
Step 3 - Short-term mitigation: create a JIT grant with minimal duration if additional operator access is required

Step 4 - SSO outage procedure: (a) check IdP metadata endpoints and cert expiry; (b) if cert rotation is required, prepare new metadata and test in staging; (c) if immediate mitigation needed, follow 'pause SSO enforcement' to allow fallback auth (audit all fallback events)
Step 5 - Post-incident hardening: rotate any compromised keys, expand audit retention for the window, schedule policy reviews for implicated roles
